notes.title: Nimbatus 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
​Dear Drone Engineers,

We just released a new update! We looked through all the features that you suggested and upvoted in [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/forum/98-update-requests/]our forums[/url] and picked the ones that we liked most and were within our time limit.

The two most notable changes are the new multiselection feature that let's you select and edit multiple drone parts at once by pressing CTRL. And the dronepart template system where you can create templates and use them accross your drones. 
 
[h2]Discount and Drone Building Contest[/h2]
To celebrate the update the full game Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor is 25% off for the next two weeks!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/383840/Nimbatus__The_Space_Drone_Constructor/

Also we are running a drone building contest in our Discord, where you can win Steam keys for Nimbatus. Head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/c7tgxrc]Discord [/url]to participate!

We are also running a [url=https://twitter.com/NimbatusGame/status/1298304714673725441]giveaway on Twitter[/url] where you can win a Steam key for the full game!

[h2]Patchnotes 1.1.2[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3][list]
[*] Drone Part Multiselection: Press Ctrl and click on multiple drone parts or press CTRL and drag a rectangle to select multiple parts. If the parts are of the same type you can edit them all at once.
[*] Drone Part Templates: You can create templates of drone parts, store them and use them when building different drones.
[*] New Tutorials to learn magnets and tags
[*] Exit without save button for the drone workshop
[/list]
[h3]New Drone Parts[/h3][list]
[*] Wheels
[*] Grappling Hook
[*] Ballast Tank
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3][list]
[*] Added linear option for springs,  this allows for better suspension for wheels
[/list]

Cheers,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Nimbatus - Full Release out now!

notes.title: Nimbatus - Drone Creator Release & Building Competition!
notes.notes:
Dear Drone Engineers,

We just released the Nimbatus Drone Creator! ːsteamhappyː
The Drone Creator is the standalone drone editor from Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor. You can build and test drones using the full range of drone parts from the full game.

[previewyoutube=bBNPk3wZ7UE;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the release, we host a drone building competition!  The deadline to enter a drone is May 7th. Winners will be announced shortly after and will receive 1 of 3 Steam keys for the full game ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383840/Nimbatus__The_Space_Drone_Constructor/]Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor[/url])!

[h3]Here is how you can enter the building competition:[/h3]
- [b]Build[/b] the smartest, coolest looking or most creative drone ever.
- [b]Create a GIF[/b] of the drone (press F9 to create a GIF of the last 10 seconds in the game) or record one otherwise.
-[b] Post your creation[/b] in [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/topic/9513-nimbatus-drone-creator-release-today/]this thread[/url] in our forums, or on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/Jhes5Ku]Discord[/url] or share them on Twitter with #DroneCreator to enter the competition

We hope you enjoy the Drone Creator and build many awesome things with it!

​Cheers,
Stray Fawn Studio
